entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand sensor. It's ridiculous. I want my money back now.
I can certainly look into that for you. I just need to pull up your account details. Can I get your full name and order number, please?
The name is Sam Jones. The order number is VF88675. And don't give me the runaround, I'm a VIP member and I expect this to be handled immediately.

Thank you, Sam. I see your account here and appreciate your loyalty with VeloFit. I've located the order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's no 'fault'. It was a total impulse buy and I just changed my mind. I don't use it, and I'm not going to. I want a refund. Simple.
Okay, I understand. So you're looking to return it because it wasn't the right fit for your routine. Let me just check the policy for you.

Check what? There's nothing to check! I bought it, I don't want it. If you don't process this refund I'm going straight to my credit card company and I'll be leaving reviews on every single website I can find. Do you want that? I can get a manager on the line right now if you can't handle this.

That won't be necessary, Sam. I apologize for the delay. I've just consulted our knowledge base. It looks like you're well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a full refund for you today.
Oh. Okay, good. That's what I expected.

Of course. No sense in having you hold onto a product you don't use, and we certainly want to save you the hassle of trying to handle a private resale. I have initiated the return. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
Alright, I see the email. So I'll get the full amount back to my card?

Yes, that's correct. Once our warehouse receives the item, the full purchase price will be credited back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. As a courtesy for the trouble, I've also added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchase. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
